column3: “Rock you were dug” is rendered “rock from which you were hewn,” and “excavation of the pit” as “quarry.”
NASB adds “in pain,” and “if one” is rendered “When he was one.”
“He made” is rendered “He will make,” and “desert plain” as “desert.”
“I will make suddenly” is rendered “I will set,” joining “suddenly” to the next verse sense.
“The heavens” is rendered “the sky,” and “in like manner” renders “like gnats”; the meaning is uncertain.
“She who cut” is rendered “You who cut,” and “sea monster” as “dragon.”
“One who stoops” is rendered “The exile,” and “the pit” as “the dungeon.”
NASB puts “the LORD of hosts is His name” in parentheses.
“To plant the heavens” is rendered “to establish the heavens.”
“Who will show sympathy” is rendered “Who will mourn for you,” and “who do I comfort you” as “How shall I comfort you,” following a different reading.
